_comment: FOLK progressions. Chord progressions are freely copyable (settled law); families from docs/idiom-research/genre-rock-pop.md section E2. Plain triads everywhere (color comes from open strings, never jazz stacks); modal families avoid the major V (corny trap 3): dorian i-IV, Appalachian double-tonic i-bVII, aeolian i-bVII-bVI. In minor mode degree 7 = bVII and 6 = bVI; quality overrides make the dorian IV and double-tonic bVII major.
